title: Geo-aware ingest gating and residency-proof controller for usage events
creator: Aisha Kumari
description: Background: Our analytics ingestion currently fans events into a single global topic which is then consumed by downstream materialized views. Several customers require demonstrable residency controls and a tamper-evident proof that certain tenants' telemetry never left approved regions. This ticket designs and implements a geo-aware gating layer and a lightweight residency-proof controller that enforces write affinity, emits immutable residency attestations, and provides a migration path for historical events.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ingest gateway can accept a per-tenant region policy and enforce write gating: rejects writes from disallowed regions with clear error codes.

2) Residency-proof controller produces an append-only attestation record per tenant-per-batch that includes: tenant_id, source_region, ingress_timestamp, policy_snapshot_id, cryptographic-hash of event batch, and origin_signature.
3) Downstream analytics materialized views can be configured to only project events whose attestation proves residency in an allowed region.
4) Automated integration tests that simulate cross-region writes and validate rejections, attestations, and eventual-consistency of replicated partitions.
5) Dashboard tile and Alerting: number of blocked writes, attestation generation latency (p95 < 150ms), and percentage of events with valid attestations.
6) Migration runbook to backfill attestations for a bounded historical window (configurable TTL) without violating privacy or duplication guarantees.
tasks: Design ingest gateway extension: add tenant-policy lookup, geo-IP resolution fallback, and explicit origin-region header honoring.
Implement residency-proof controller service: attestation schema, signing keys (KMS), retention policy, and audit log integration.
Extend analytics consumers to filter by attestation validity and region allowlist.
Create e2e test harness simulating multi-region producers and consumer gating.
Instrument metrics and traces for gating decisions and attestation pipeline.
Author migration/backfill runbook and safety fence to disable backfill if blocked writes spike > threshold.
Perform security review and obtain approvals for storing hashes and signatures in telemetry bucket.
deployment_steps: 1) Deploy ingest gateway change behind a feature flag (feature:geo-ingest-gating).
2) Deploy residency-proof controller in region A only, mark replication-disabled mode for canary tenants.
3) Enable attestations for a small set of internal tenants and observe metrics for 48 hours.
4) Gradually expand tenant cohort by region using percentage ramp; monitor blocked-writes and attestation generation latency.
5) Enable consumer-side filtering via opt-in header; rollback by toggling consumer filter and gateway flag.
6) Once stable, enable KMS-backed signing key rotation and move controller to multi-region active-active with leader election.
7) Schedule backfill window during low-traffic period and run with safety fences enabled.
migration_plan: Phase 1: Non-destructive attestation backfill for the last 30 days into the attestation index; do not alter event payloads.
Phase 2: Run a canary backfill for 5 tenants and validate consumer filters accept backfilled attestations.
Phase 3: Full backfill in hourly batches, monitor for duplication or consumer-side confusion (idempotency keys included in attestation).
Phase 4: After backfill completes and monitors are green for 72 hours, flip strict-enforcement for read-only views to reject events without attestations.
Phase 5: Document TTL/retention of attestations and plan for archive if required by customer contract.
observability_and_metrics: Metric: blocked_writes.count with labels tenant_id, region, policy_id.
Dashboard: Region heatmap showing blocked vs allowed writes by tenant and hour.
Alert: blocked_writes.count increases by 3x baseline over 10m for any tenant -> paging to oncall.
rollback_plan: Toggle feature flag to disable geo-ingest-gating immediately.
Blacklist attestation consumer filter so materialized views accept raw events irrespective of attestations.
Revoke new signing key and revert to previous key state if attestation format regression observed.
If backfill causes duplicate projections, trigger idempotent replay using attestation.batch_hash dedup table.
notes: Key trade-off: full cryptographic proof for every event increases token volume and cost; we use batch-level proofs and batch_hash to balance cost vs auditability.
We intentionally separate attestation storage (immutable index) from event payload storage to enforce different retention policies per contract.
Privacy note: attestations contain only hashes and metadata, not PII. Confirmed with Privacy that batch_hash is acceptable for compliance logs.
Future work: extend controller to emit verifiable receipts customers can fetch and independently verify using public keys.
